{{Quote|Exal Kressh. You are a traitor to your blood and your Empire.''"<br />"''You'd kill me for that? The Dark Council's hound against a girl just out of stasis. Good luck trying.|Teneb Kel and Exal Kressh|<ref name="BotE2" />}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]], a '''duel''' between [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]] and [[Exal Kressh]] occurred on [[Lenico Colony Blue]], a [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Lenico IV]]. Kel, a disgraced [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], was tasked by the [[Dark Council]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to [[Hunt for Exal Kressh|hunt down and eliminate]] Kressh, a traitor to the Empire and the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] former apprentice. Over a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] earlier, Kressh had abandoned the Empire and began leaking confidential Imperial intelligence to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] adversaries in the war, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with the intent to disrupt the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Essence transfer|life-twisting]] [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith rituals]]. Kressh traveled to Lenico after managing to flee from the Empire's [[Agent/Legends|agents]], hoping that entering a medically-induced [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]] would prevent her former [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] from detecting her [[The Force/Legends|Force]] presence.

Intending to bring an end to her [[Treason/Legends|treason]], Kel tracked Kressh to Lenico Colony Blue, where he found her emerging from her state of suspended animation. The two quickly [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|entered]] into [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]], and although Kel fought ferociously, Kressh's superior [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] skills and command of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] overwhelmed the young apprentice. The melee resulted in extensive damage to the station's medical facilities and superstructure, crippling the [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] and forcing its denizens to evacuate. Although Kel attempted to defend himself for a [[Time/Legends|time]], he was severely wounded and his bid to capture the Emperor's rogue apprentice ultimately failed. Kressh allowed her adversary to flee from the engagement before continuing to ruin Lenico Colony Blue and send it hurtling toward the surface of Lenico IV. In doing so, she covered her own flight from the facility and trapped Kel and her other pursuers on the surface of the dead world, granting herself time to [[Battle over Korriban|continue]] her treason and further subvert the Emperor's goals.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Exal Kressh was the ''Emperor''{{'s}} apprentice. Fifty-two days ago, she abandoned her duties in the Kathol Rift and fled toward Republic space. She is a traitor. You will find her and slay her.|Darth Marr, to Teneb Kel|<ref name="BotE1" />}}
[[File:Kressh_sells_out.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Exal Kressh provides Republic agents with Imperial secrets.]]
During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Exal Kressh]] served in the exalted position of [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. Throughout the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the conflict, the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] trained his pupil to master the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and sent her on missions across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to collect knowledge of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] and dark side rituals. Unbeknownst to Kressh, her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] was simultaneously working to drain her of her own free will and fill her mind with his thoughts and commands,<ref name="BotE2" /> intending to turn her into the first of his "[[Children of the Emperor|Children]]." The Children of the Emperor were to be a group of beings brainwashed by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Magic/Legends|magic]] into becoming literal extensions of the Emperor's will<ref name="BotE3" />&mdash;at any moment he could activate them and [[Essence transfer|fill them with his essence]], seeing through their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and controlling their actions.<ref name="The First Son">{{TORcite|type=codex|The First Son (Consular)}}</ref> Kressh was largely unaware of the Emperor's intentions until approximately [[3678 BBY]], when her Master sent her on a mission to the dead [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Lenico IV]]. There, she discovered a [[Ortolan tribe|tribe]] of [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]] who practiced similar [[Shaman/Legends|shamanistic]] rituals to [[Immortality/Legends|indefinitely perpetuate]] the life of a leader.<ref name="BotE2" />

It was there that Kressh realized what the Emperor had been doing to her throughout her apprenticeship. Horrified, she [[Massacre on Lenico IV|massacred]] the Ortolan tribe and fled from the Empire shortly thereafter, hoping to rid herself of the Emperor and stop his creation of more Children.<ref name="BotE2" /> To the latter end, she began leaking [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] secrets to the Galactic Republic, all the while being tormented by the continuing presence of the Emperor in her mind. As word of a rogue Sith apprentice spread, both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Empire's [[Dark Council]] began efforts to [[Hunt for Exal Kressh|hunt her down]], albeit for different reasons.<ref name="BotE1" /> Knowing that the Emperor was able to track her through her own thoughts and experiences, Kressh returned to Lenico IV, reasoning that her history with the location would confuse the Emperor's perceptions of her whereabouts. To further the deception, the rogue Sith put herself into [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]] aboard the [[Medcenter/Legends|medical]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] [[Lenico Colony Blue]], one of six artificial [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the planet.<ref name="BotE2" />

Kressh's previous experiences with Lenico IV and her stasis-induced [[Sleep/Legends|dreams]] did confound the Emperor and prevented him from remotely entering her mind, but her former Master was ultimately able to sense that she was indeed in the [[Lenico system/Legends|Lenico system]]. Under the command of their sovereign, the Dark Council charged another disgraced apprentice with the duty to find and destroy Kressh&mdash;[[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male and aspiring [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]]. Together with his [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Qawohl|Maggot]], Kel searched the various [[Realspace/Legends|space]] stations orbiting Lenico IV until finally arriving on Colony Blue to confront its [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]], [[Baron-Surgeon]] [[Ybann]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Although the Hutt was of little help in the hunt, Kel continued to search the station until happening upon the stasis chambers.<ref name="BotE1" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|Are you really all they sent? A hungry, frightened acolyte? You think if you murder me, you'll become the Emperor's ''next'' apprentice?|Exal Kressh, to Teneb Kel|<ref name="BotE2" />}}
[[File:Kel_vs_Kressh.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Kressh dominates Kel.]]
Upon entering Lenico Colony Blue's stasis chambers, Kel inadvertently activated security measures meant to protect the sleeping patients. As such, a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] began revivification of Kressh, who quickly awoke and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|armed]] herself, choosing to hide among the facility's myriad [[Stasis pod|containment tubes]] and hallways while taunting her pursuer. After a [[Time/Legends|time]] she revealed herself and swiftly blasted Kel with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], flinging him backward into tubes of crystalline [[permaglass]]. The young Sith hunter quickly recovered and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] hurl the shards of shattered permaglass at his assailant, although the counterattack failed to meet its mark due to Kressh's superior command of the Force. Continuing to taunt him, Kressh again flung arcs of lightning at Kel as he fled from the chamber. While Kel quoted the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|Code of the Sith]] to gather his resolve, the rogue apprentice followed him with a cadre of medical [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were emitting an aerosol of toxic, coma-inducing gas.<ref name="BotE2" />

To escape the contaminated air, Kel cut a hole in the chamber's floor and fled into the lower levels to hide among the station's [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. With a blast of Force lightning, the apprentice detonated one of the generators, only to find Kressh hiding behind it, prepared to strike. Again Kel tried to defend himself with lightning, but the rogue Sith caught it with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blade and turned it back against its caster. Kel was thrown to the floor in the [[Fire/Legends|flaming]] rubble of the generator, thoroughly defeated. Kressh approached to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her pursuer but instead offered him a choice: either she would reveal the Emperor's plans and then kill him, or allow him to flee and preserve his life. Kel chose the latter and quickly fled the scene while Kressh stayed behind to continue sabotaging Lenico Colony Blue.<ref name="BotE2" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Just you and me, alone again. Like in the old days, when you crawled through my veins and filled my mind&hellip;|Exal Kressh, communicating telepathically with the Emperor|<ref name="BotE2" />}}
[[File:Colony_Blue_burns.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Exal Kressh watches as Lenico Colony Blue burns upon entering the atmosphere of Lenico IV.]]
Kel escaped the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|melee]] by falling through a hole blasted in the station's bulkhead and landing on a [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] below. Kressh, meanwhile, used the Force to disable the station's vital [[Verbobrain/Legends|verbobrain]] clusters, causing an cascade of system failures across Lenico Colony Blue. The integrity of the station's [[Power core/Legends|power core]] dropped drastically as the station's orbit began to deteriorate, causing panic throughout the structure. The satellite's denizens quickly began to flee as Kel tried to reconnect with Maggot and escape aboard his [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class interceptor]]. Although he reached its mooring at docking pylon four, the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay's [[Magnetic field/Legends|containment field]] was failing rapidly, venting the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] into space and tearing the surrounding structure apart with it. Using the Force, the heavily wounded Kel was able to use the colony's rubble to guide himself back to his vessel, where he found Maggot waiting for his return. Like many of the medstation's other escapees&mdash;including Kressh's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] pursuers&mdash;the Sith apprentice and his slave were forced to seek refuge and ship repairs on the dead surface of Lenico IV.<ref name="BotE2" />

The station ultimately fell entirely out of orbit and plummeted to the surface of Lenico IV, burning up in the atmosphere as it descended. Kressh escaped largely unscathed from Lenico Colony Blue aboard her [[X-70B Phantom-class prototype|X-70B ''Phantom''-class]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], but once again heard the voice of the Emperor in her mind, driving her deeper into insanity. Despite the mental intrusion, she had succeeded in losing her hunters and once again resumed her plan to prevent the creation of the Children of the Sith Emperor.<ref name="BotE2" /> To that end, she pushed forward to the Sith holy world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in the [[Horuset system]], where she ignited a major [[Battle over Korriban|battle]] between Republic and Imperial forces before once again being confronted by Teneb Kel.<ref name="BotE3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The duel on Lenico Colony Blue first appeared in the online [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire]]'', released in [[2010]] on [http://www.swtor.com ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website] and written by [[Alexander Freed]]. The action of the battle was primarily concentrated in the comic's second entry, [[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 2: The Broken World|''Act 2: The Broken World'']],<ref name="BotE2" /> which was re-released later that year in printed format as [[The Old Republic 5|''The Old Republic 5: Blood of the Empire, Part 2'']]. ''Blood of the Empire'' was the second of three ''Old Republic'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story arcs created as a tie-in to the online [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="BotE2 print">[[The Old Republic 5|''The Old Republic'' 5]]</ref>
